en: When tomorrow night comes...and we all die...
I wonder what Monokuma is gonna do?
Will he end it...or just start a new one...?
Relax! I'm not gonna die anytime soon!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time trying to prevent Kokichi
from doing anything stupid...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today.
